transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to hold a batch-disposition huddle for Batch H-418. As you know, a cure-temperature alarm appeared during the Tuesday night run on Press 8. The electronic record shows the programmed temperature was within spec, but we still need to follow our standard procedure. I'll need the lab report and a pallet-level traceability check for pallets P1 through P4 before I can make a final disposition decision. Let's get started.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Elena, I've completed the differential-scanning-calorimetry review of the retained samples from Batch H-418. The results confirm that exactly 240 housings are undercured. They will require a 4-hour thermal rework, and all 240 reworked housings must undergo a hardness test before release. I should note that my final lab report is still awaiting upload to the quality system, so I'm sharing these findings with you directly now.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Elena, I've completed the pallet-level serial lookup after the alarm. The 240 affected housings are exactly the 120 units on P2 and the 120 units on P3. P1 and P4 contain the 760 unaffected housings. I haven't attached the lookup to the batch record yet since the disposition huddle wasn't completed, but I'm providing this to you now.
transcript.speaker: A3

decisions.disposition: Split disposition: Release P1 and P4 (760 unaffected housings) pending documentation upload. Hold P2 and P3 (240 undercured housings) for 4-hour thermal rework followed by 100% hardness testing before release.
decisions.shipment_release_plan: P1 and P4 may be released for shipment once Ravi uploads the final lab report and Marta attaches the pallet-level lookup to the batch record. P2 and P3 are held until the 240 undercured housings complete the 4-hour thermal rework and pass 100% hardness testing, at which point they may be released.

commitments.detail: Upload final DSC lab report for Batch H-418 to the quality system before any pallets are released.
Attach pallet-level serial lookup to the batch record for Batch H-418 before any pallets are released.
Perform 4-hour thermal rework on the 240 undercured housings from P2 and P3.
Perform 100% hardness testing on all 240 reworked housings from P2 and P3 before release.
